brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;half-n with drawer:0#0,0#cut on its cut face (southern exposure). check_build shows no error, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: No spike present in current build. Previous triple-cluster (0,0/0,1/1,0) was removed to create half-base for drawer; current 4-piece layout (-1,0,-1,1,0,1 + half-n 0,0) offers no spike socket after check.

requirements.requirement: Small platform held on the spike
requirements.evidence: Requires spike with platform-sm/lrg accessory; no spike exists, so platform cannot be placed.

finish.summary: Built compact desk unit: half-n base at 0,0 with drawer on cut face. Spike/platform requirement could not be retained simultaneously in the compact footprint within remaining turns; check_build is clear (warnings LOOSE_BODY, OPEN_CAP_FACE only).

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
